items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Is active for Sunday's game
items.text:
Waddle (chest) is active for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jake Ferguson: Ruled out for rest of game
items.text:
Ferguson (ankle) won't return to Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Joe Hoyt reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kendrick Bourne: Won't reenter Sunday's game
items.text:
Bourne won't return to Sunday's contest at Dallas due to a right high-ankle sprain, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bam Knight: Forced out of Sunday's game
items.text:
Knight headed to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Cowboys after sustaining an unspecified injury, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kendrick Bourne: Heads to locker room Sunday
items.text:
Bourne sustained an apparent right leg injury late in the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Cowboys and headed to the locker room, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
